120000100.sourceGeometryScope: all Run-018 closure-created or subsequently changed open faces; complete parent support is carried in source-view CSR

120000102.sourceGeometryScope: single witness connected patch, fixed seven-vertex boundary

exactParentNearTieFallbackPolicy: Fallback runs only after the existing floating tie guard rejects distinct projections. Exact binary64 rationals select the global nearest projection using a complete same-material exact-AABB candidate certificate. Exact equal-distance distinct projections still reject.
face_ancestry_source_arrays: face_source_original_id,face_source_identity0,face_source_identity1 plus pinned face_source_identity_schema_by_original_id_json in each candidate NPZ
full86WeightMethod: For each candidate node, interpolate the exact captured parent node full86 vectors with the selected current-world parent tet barycentrics. The dominant binding pose owns RegisteredSurface donor/local frame fields; parent geometric donor/material/region remain separate registration labels and source-namespace identity remains separate.

limits.selectedTie: minimum distance then lowest parent_tet_row among geometrically indistinguishable projections

method: node source identity is direct row identity into each exact Boolean candidate NPZ; nearest current parent registration is bounded to the layer material set; full86 weights are interpolated by parent tet barycentrics; donor/local frames use the dominant interpolated binding pose, separately from parent geometric donor and cell labels.

parentFull86Weights.sourceMeaning: actual WholeBodySkinSourceConsumerRows fullBodyWeights86 captured on the exact parent node domain
